question: Who among the following was awarded the Padma Vibhushan, India’s second highest civilian award, for his contribution to Performing Arts?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Uday Shankar**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uday Shankar** was an **Indian dancer** and choreographer best recognized for developing a** fusion form** of dance that combined aspects of Indian classical, folk, and indigenous dance with dramatic methods from** Europe**.
 
• Throughout the **1920s** and **1930s**, he promoted this type of dancing in India, Europe, and the United States. He was a **contemporary dance innovator** in India.
 
• He **received** the **Sangeet Natak Akademi **Fellowship for lifelong accomplishment in 1962 from Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy for Music, Dance, and Drama, and in **1971**, the Indian government gave him the** Padma Vibhushan**, its second-highest civilian honor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 After the Bharat Ratna, the **Padma Vibhushan** is the **second-highest civilian honor **bestowed by the Indian Republic.
 
 
• The award was **established** on **January 2nd**, 1954, and is granted for remarkable and illustrious service.
 
• **All people**, regardless of ethnicity, profession, status, or sexual orientation, are** eligible** for these honors.
 
• The Padma Awards Committee, which the **Prime Minister of India** established, receives nominations for the honor between **May 1** and **September 15** of each year.
